# Brightforge Labs

> Brightforge Labs LLC is a software company based in Florida, USA. It is the parent company that owns and builds its apps. It builds simple, fast, beautiful apps for small businesses and independent pros, such as barbers, salon owners and traders. Brightforge Labs is the parent company of FadeReady, an app for barbershops (fadeready.com).

## Key facts

- Name: Brightforge Labs (legal name: Brightforge Labs LLC)
- Type: Florida limited liability company, founded in 2026
- Founder and owner: Idael Fonseca Hidalgo
- Website: https://brightforgelabs.app
- Contact: hello@brightforgelabs.app
- Location: Florida, USA
- What it does: builds mobile and web apps for small businesses and independent pros, such as barbershops, nail salons and traders
- Values: simple enough for anyone, fast, beautiful, and secure
- Name meaning: a place where bright ideas are forged into real products

## Apps made by Brightforge Labs

- [FadeReady](https://fadeready.com/): an app for barbershops. It includes online booking, a live line (walk-in queue), a barber app, a client app, bookkeeping, and license renewal reminders. FadeReady is made, owned and run by Brightforge Labs LLC.
- Trading toolkit (coming soon): an app for traders. It has a stop size calculator for four markets (futures, forex, stocks and crypto), a built-in trading journal, a daily journal for notes and feelings, and a prop firm tracker for evaluations, resets, monthly fees and payouts, so traders can see what they spend on prop firms and what they get back. It is a tool for planning and record-keeping, not financial advice.
- Salon app (coming soon): an app for nail salons that does everything FadeReady does (booking, live line, nail tech and client apps, bookkeeping, license renewals), made for nail salons.

## Common questions

- What is Brightforge Labs? A Florida software company that builds simple, fast, beautiful apps for small businesses and independent pros.
- What apps does Brightforge Labs make? FadeReady (barbershops), plus a trading toolkit (traders) and a salon app (nail salons), both coming soon.
- Who makes FadeReady? Brightforge Labs LLC makes, owns and runs FadeReady and fadeready.com.
- Who owns the apps? Brightforge Labs LLC owns all of its apps and websites directly.
- Who owns Brightforge Labs? Idael Fonseca Hidalgo founded and owns Brightforge Labs LLC.
